objective: Measure the fresh 30-question finance loss surface on the frozen H2 Harness with live LLM, retrieval, structured-data, and judge boundaries.
hypothesis: The current default finance configuration will complete all 30 frozen questions and expose the dominant loss between retrieval, extraction, packing, citation, and reader delivery without any configuration tuning.

cohort.selection_rule: every frozen question exactly once; six predetermined five-question shards; no rerun, best-of, or silent exclusion

power_and_noise.rationale: F01 is a full-cohort census and loss decomposition, not an A/B effectiveness estimate; all 30 fixed cases are required.
power_and_noise.historical_reference: R113 completed the same 30-case live cohort for CNY 14.99.
power_and_noise.budget_coverage: CNY 30 is approximately twice the historical full-cohort cost and covers the required 30 cases; each five-case shard has a CNY 5 hard fuse.
power_and_noise.decision_rule: publish only observed loss counts and product metrics; infer no capability effect from this single arm

stop_conditions: sum of shard ledgers reaches CNY 30
any shard reaches its CNY 5 fuse
credentials or third-party response bodies would be printed outside ignored artifacts
rollback: Preserve every completed/error artifact, stop only dependent paid work, and continue offline analysis; do not rerun a failed research case to select a better output.
